items.description: AI agent orchestration for open and closed source — a fully customizable fleet of AI agents covering every level of project maintenance, from brainstorming to full autonomy
items.readme_text:
Hive

Useful work. Clear limits. A record you can follow.

Get started · Overview · How Hive works (video) · Community

--- Hive helps people and AI agents work together across their projects. It connects the work, the rules and the review history. Bring your own agents. You decide what they can do. Keep code in **GitHub or GitHub Enterprise**. Bring tasks from **GitHub Issues, GitHub Projects, Linear or Jira**. [See integrations](src/docs/integrations.md). ## Trust **See whether feedback leads to a change.** Hive keeps reviews and updates together. You can see what was asked, what changed and who approved it. ![A response to review](docs/readme/trust-followup.svg) Pull requests revised, then approved: **65.5% (369 / 563)**. Of 563 pull requests sent back for changes, 369 had an updated version approved. The other 194 had no later approval recorded. Approval does not prove the code is right. [Data](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/6c7cb37b9ef20830d23795ee248e552705c3acc1/src/docs/benchmarks/outcomes-2026-10.json) · [How it was counted](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/6c7cb37b9ef20830d23795ee248e552705c3acc1/src/docs/benchmarks/outcomes-2026-10.md#what-the-readme-shows-and-leaves-out) [How reviews are tracked](src/docs/review-evidence.md). ## Productivity **Move useful work forward.** Hive works on issues, pull requests and failed checks. People and agents share the work. ![People and agents moving work forward](docs/readme/productivity-authors.svg) **857** agent-authored, **528** human-authored and **70** bot-authored pull requests. October 27, 2026: 1,455 merged pull requests with a Hive review, from one Hive. These counts do not measure time saved or productivity gained. [Data](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/6c7cb37b9ef20830d23795ee248e552705c3acc1/src/docs/benchmarks/outcomes-2026-10.json) · [How it was counted](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/6c7cb37b9ef20830d23795ee248e552705c3acc1/src/docs/benchmarks/outcomes-2026-10.md#scale) For example, a review caught a compile error in [pluk#328](https://github.com/hivecommons/pluk/pull/328#pullrequestreview-5607075007). An updated version was approved about ten minutes later. ## Efficiency **Cut repeat work.** Task claims help avoid duplicate work. Budgets and retry limits keep failed attempts from running on. Contributors can use their own agents and model plans. Their model keys stay on their machines. [Share work](src/docs/contributor-relay.md) · [Set limits](src/docs/security-model.md). ## Governance **Decide who can do what before the work starts.** Set who can view, change settings and merge. Keep human holds and your repo's branch rules. Hive also checks outside text for hidden instructions before an agent reads it. ![Test the boundary](docs/readme/governance-input-attacks.svg) Attack text kept from the agent: **96.8% (61 / 63)**. Hive's own test, October 23, 2026. Two of 63 attack inputs got through. This small test does not show how well Hive stops real attacks. [Test and misses](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/6c7cb37b9ef20830d23795ee248e552705c3acc1/src/docs/ioscan-red-team.md#results) · [Data](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/6c7cb37b9ef20830d23795ee248e552705c3acc1/src/docs/benchmarks/red-team-2026-10.json) The filter made mistakes too: it removed safe text in **1 of 12 harmless test cases**. [Permissions](src/docs/acmm-policy-matrix.md) · [Test details](src/docs/ioscan-red-team.md). ## Auditability **See what happened and why.** Logs show actions and who took them. Review records link a change to its reviews and checks. These records must be enabled. Some fields and signatures are optional. They are not a complete audit. [Review records](src/docs/review-evidence.md) · [Activity logs](src/docs/audit-log.md). ## What Hive adds An agent can write code. Hive connects agents to a shared queue, project rules and review records. ![What Hive adds to your agents](docs/readme/workflow.svg) Work stays with the project, not just one chat. You can bring different agents and run several Hives under one hub. [How it fits together](src/docs/architecture.md) · [Agent setup](src/docs/agent-configuration.md). ### About the numbers The review charts use an October 27 snapshot from one Hive. They show activity, not time saved or proof of better code. [Sources and limits](src/docs/benchmarks/outcomes-2026-10.md#methodology). ## Install Start with the [getting-started guide](src/docs/getting-started.md). ```bash git clone https://github.com/hivecommons/hive.git cd hive ``` Choose how to run it: | Run Hive | Start here | | --- | --- | | Docker Compose | [Compose quick start](src/docs/quickstart-docker-compose.md) | | Podman | [Podman quick start](src/docs/quickstart-podman.md) | | Kubernetes | [Deployment guide](src/docs/kubernetes-deployment.md) | | Hosted | [Hosted guide](src/docs/hosted-hub.md) · [Open the service](https://hive.hivecommons.dev) | Use official images from `ghcr.io/hivecommons/hive`. ## Community [How Hive works (video)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uo1KGTyJJyU) · [First contribution](docs/getting-started-contributing.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Contribute compute](src/docs/contributor-relay.md) · [Discord](https://hivecommons.dev/discord) · [Community meeting](https://docs.hivecommons.dev/docs/community/meetings) · [Live stream (Twitch)](https://www.twitch.tv/hivecommons) · [Discussions](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/discussions). items.name: StoryMoss
items.description: 🌿 StoryMoss (草苔) — AI导演式小说创作系统。Tauri+Rust驱动的桌面写作软件，集成知识图谱、伏笔追踪、StyleDNA风格引擎、协同编辑、7阶段全自动创作工作流。让AI成为你的创作搭档，越写越懂你。
items.readme_text:
StoryMoss · 草苔

🌿 越写越懂的 AI 小说创作桌面应用
幕后管理故事资产，幕前沉浸式写作，AI 在需要时随行辅助

--- ## ✨ 核心特性 | | 特性 | 说明 | | :---: | --- | --- | | 🎬 | **双界面创作** | 幕前「墨纸」沉浸写作 + 幕后「机械」工作室管理，两套设计语言各得其所 | | 🎛️ | **自适应幕后工作台** | 暗色主题、容器感知卡片与表单、独立面板滚动；800×600 到宽屏均无逐字竖排、固定限高裁切或悬浮遮挡 | | 🤖 | **Agency 多代理创作** | 主创 / 管理 / 编辑审计三代理黑板并行协作，每章经 Gate v2 加权质量门（代码 0.2 / 规则 0.3 / 编辑 0.5，阈值 0.75）才交付；你的修改率作为独立信号回流 | | 🗂️ | **语料资产** | 新闻 / 故事 / 概念 / 灵感 / 图片 / 链接 / 笔记按故事隔离；支持导入、AI 提炼、转为角色/世界观/伏笔草稿、交给导演调度 | | 🎬 | **导演 Agent 与剧组对话** | 代理工作室三栏：导演统筹管理 / 编审 / 主创；子 agent 异步派发、心跳、租约、重试与审批；幕后可直接 @ 三个 agent | | ⚡ | **分时介入架构** | 幕前续写走三角色主创、编辑审计后台化；划词改写仍可走完整质检——解开「质量与速度不可兼得」的根本矛盾 | | 🧠 | **越写越懂你** | 持续学习：从创作事件观察模式 → 提炼 instinct → 确认后晋升为可复用技能；Tab 接受 / Esc 放弃还会回灌到每拍写作手法的选择（章法偏好） | | 🧭 | **长篇记性与计划** | 续写前按需检索前文原文（【前文相关原文】只读块）；卷/弧中层计划（卷目标 / 卷末高潮 / 须兑现伏笔）；改稿后下游章纲标记待重规划、逐条勾选才落库——长篇不崩的四件套 | | 🧪 | **判官一致率与文笔校准** | 「创作评估」按你的改动核对编辑的每条审查意见（判得准不准有数字）；文笔基线阈值经公版人类语料校准（`resources/voice_corpus/`） | | 📝 | **PROBLEM 七元素** | 简单指令自动基于 Erik Bork 七元素增强为强力 Logline，驱动大纲与续写 | | 🌍 | **资产强关联** | 世界观 / 故事大纲 / 场景大纲 / 用户指令四位一体显式调和，剧情不跑偏 | | 🔄 | **资产回流** | 每章正文生成后自动提取角色 / 关系 / 世界观 / 大纲回流累积进资产库，手工编辑永不覆盖，续写越写越强关联 | | 🔌 | **多模型适配** | OpenAI / Anthropic / Ollama / 本地 API，角色 × 任务模型路由 | | 🔄 | **双源自动更新** | GitHub Releases 优先、官网备用；清单与下载网络故障自动换源，备用源限同一版本，签名验证始终启用 | | 📚 | **全链路资产管理** | 角色 / 世界构建 / 场景 / 知识图谱 / 伏笔看板 / 叙事分析 / 拆书，AI 不「吃书」 | | ❤️ | **情感回路** | 单拍强制「事件→评估→情绪变化→行动/台词→代价」因果链；批量续写按章生成 1–3 幕；关系张力账本、情感债务与读者面板；情感驱动情节，不是形容词 | | 🧩 | **叙事契约** | 每拍先编译场契约（目标 / 具名阻力 / 转折 / 必须结果 / 情感链 / 字数），writer 按这一页写；gate 对具名阻力缺席、正文过短、契约无效硬拦截；幕后选中另一部小说即切换，生成中也不静默拒绝 | | 🧵 | **多 write 并行** | 同一故事最多 3 个 write 任务并行；章号由数据库原子分配，Append 同章排队，资产补齐加租约，不抢号、不重复造资产 | | 📌 | **固定语料** | 语料页「固定用于续写」后，素材以只读块进入单拍/批量 writer prompt（≤4 条、≤1200 字）；图片语料读取尺寸/摘要；deepseek-v4.1-flash 等视觉模型可读原图，作者可强制 AI 遵守/化用 | | 🪪 | **姓名编译** | 创世角色名做重名 / 同用字 / 同姓扎堆 / 长度塌缩 / 模型陈词组合校验；常见姓可正常使用，但不再整组「林雪/沈夜/苏墨/顾寒」式二字塌缩 | --- ## 📸 界面预览

幕前 · 极简全屏写作，AI 输入栏随行辅助，文思模式主动给萤火提示

幕后 · 故事 / 角色 / 世界构建 / 场景 / 知识图谱 / 代理工作室等全套资产管理

--- ## 🚀 安装与运行 ### 下载预构建版本 访问官网 `https://storymoss.top` 或 GitHub Releases 页面，下载对应平台安装包后直接安装即可。 ### 从源码运行 需要安装 [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/)（推荐 20 LTS）和 [Rust](https://rustup.rs/)。 仓库通过 `rust-toolchain.toml` 固定 Rust 版本为 **1.95.0**，`rustup` 会自动下载对应工具链。 ```bash # 1. 克隆仓库 git clone https://github.com/91zgaoge/StoryMoss.git cd StoryMoss # 2. 安装前端依赖 cd src-frontend && npm install # 3. 安装 Tauri CLI 并运行桌面应用 cd .. npm install -g @tauri-apps/cli cargo tauri dev ``` > **注意**：`Cargo.lock` 已纳入版本控制。如需升级依赖，请在本地验证 `cargo clippy` / `cargo test` 通过后再提交。 ### 仅运行前端（开发调试） ```bash cd src-frontend npm run dev ``` 然后在浏览器打开 `http://localhost:5173/`。 ### 构建官网落地页 ```bash cd landing npm install npm run build ``` 构建产物位于 `landing/dist/`，可部署到任意静态托管服务。开发模式运行 `npm run dev`，测试运行 `npm run test`。 --- ## 🆕 最新动态 > 完整变更日志见 [`CHANGELOG.md`](./CHANGELOG.md)。 ### v0.98.9 · 修复任务进度与执行日志显示不一致 - **问题**：任务详情头部进度已到 40%，展开的「执行日志」最新一条仍停在「进度 5%」；续写训练页的「最新日志」同样不刷新。 - **根因**：任务列表每 5 秒轮询，日志查询却只在任务完成/失败/取消时刷新；运行中的 `task-progress` 事件没有前端消费者，日志面板一直停留在展开时刻。 - **结果**：每个进度事件同时刷新任务列表与对应日志，日志随 5% → 20% → 30% → 40% 等阶段实时推进，并与头部进度、更新时间一致。 ### v0.98.8 · 修复日志自动上传提议从未触发（三处日志布局不匹配） - **问题定位**：官网日志包列表连续多日为空，本机在 11-11 手动上传后不再出现新包；排查发现自动提议从未执行到打包——诊断日志写在 `应用数据/logs/` 子目录，代码却在应用数据根目录找日志。 - **三处根因**：扫描目录少了 `logs/`；轮转文件名是 `storymoss.YYYY-MM-DD`（旧规则只认 `storymoss.log` 前缀）；生产日志是 JSON（`"level":"ERROR"`，旧规则只认纯文本 ` ERROR `）。 - **结果**：错误计数在真实环境恒为 0，自动弹窗永远不会出现；修复后本机 11-17 日志的 70 条 tracing ERROR 与 30 条工作流 ERROR 都能被识别，满足条件时启动即会询问是否上传诊断日志。 ### v0.98.7 · 续写训练报告驱动修复：连续承接、质检可信与风格 DNA 注入 - **每章承接上一章，不再「续前前章」**：批量续写时质量门与下一章 writer 并发，上一章尚未装配进正文库；旧逻辑会从 DB 读到 n-2 章。现在在途上一章的正文与大纲显式进入下一章 writer 与章纲规划，训练 10 章连续承接同一现场/人物/未完结事件。 - **质检不再「熔断后假装通过」**：编辑审计增加轮数与输出额度，输入内嵌时直接裁决 JSON，裁断输出可补括号解析；批量 deadline 按章数放大。报告区分真实通过、修订与质检降级，不再出现「10 章通过」与逐章 7 章 revise 的矛盾。 - **风格 DNA 真正生效**：续写 prompt 现在注入 StyleDNA 六维指标（此前只绑定不进 prompt），文笔有可执行的句式/用词/对话约束。 - **幻觉不再回流放大**：训练沙盒关闭生成正文的资产 ingest，指令携带原文权威人物名册；上一轮编审建议按上下文接地过滤，并把「真实后续节点」沉淀给下一轮主线对齐。 ### v0.98.6 · 修复发布门禁重跑缺陷，恢复 macOS 公证与发布 - **重跑不再被 nightly tag 误拦**：docs-guard 只与上一个稳定 tag 比较，`vX.Y.Z-nightly` 不再参与 `PREV` 选择；此前 nightly 与稳定 tag 指向同一 commit 时 diff 为空，会误判「必需文档未更新」。 - **macOS 公证恢复**：Apple Developer Program 协议续签后重新触发 macOS 签名/公证与全平台打包、官网同步与 updater 校验。 ### v0.98.5 · 训练源章节缓存 + 栗子读书 MCP 读竞态修复 - **反复训练不再重复取章**：MCP 源章节按「服务器 + 书 + 章号」缓存到本地 SQLite；第一次训练取章并回写，后续训练直接命中缓存，日志显示命中/新读数量。取章更省时，也不再反复触碰回环 HTTP。 - **配套栗子读书 v0.14.26**：服务端在 accept 后清除客户端 socket 继承的 `O_NONBLOCK`，header/body 分次到达时不再立即返回 400「请求不完整」；分离写入 1–500ms 实测全部成功。 ### v0.98.4 · 续写训练取章不再被栗子读书「请求不完整」中断 - **取章竞态可自愈**：Legado MCP 在 TCP 连接建立后立即读取请求，客户端若在连接与写请求之间被调度延迟（本机 LLM 高负载时偶发），body 未到达就会返回 400「请求不完整」。现在这类拒绝被识别为「JSON-RPC 尚未解析、工具未执行」，回环请求会安全重发一次；只读工具另有退避重试，写工具不会重复执行副作用。 - **训练不再在第 136/137 章中途判死**：同一本书连续取 20 章、风格/资产重建、续写与编审链路可继续推进。 ### v0.98.3 · 训练风格 DNA 与资产重建适配推理模型 - **JSON 截断可修复**：风格分析 JSON 中途被截断时，自动补全未闭合括号并采用已生成字段；两次尝试仍不完整才降级。 - **思维链里的 JSON 可用**：推理模型（如 deepseek-v4）把答案留在 `reasoning_content`、正文为空时，结构化任务（资产重建/风格分析）会从思维链提取最终 JSON；普通写作请求仍不会把思维链当正文。 - **不再空手重建**：资产重建提高输出额度并启用 JSON mode，世界观/大纲/角色/关系不再因一次空响应整段丢失。 ### v0.98.2 · 续写训练 10 章不再被 token 预算中途熔断 - **长批量训练不再中途判死**：run 级 token 硬熔断已暂停（`AgencyBudget::check()` 恒放行），10 章批量续写不会在 gate（编辑审计）阶段因累计 30 万 token 报「预算耗尽」而整批失败；token 用量仍照常记账，运行检查点与成本观测不受影响。 ### v0.98.1 · 本地书籍训练的取章起点修复 - **固定起点不再跳过首章**：本地 epub/txt 作为训练源时，起始章号现在按 1-based 正确转换为 0-based 切片起点；此前「从指定章连取」会跳过指定章本身并整体错一位。默认（第 1 章起）与 MCP 源不受影响。 ### v0.98.0 · 续写训练升级：连续续写 10 章 + 编审 Agent 全面对比 - **一次训练写 10 章**：续写训练默认连续续写 **10 章**（可在训练页配置 1–20 章），上下文默认 10 章；沙盒按章号连续承接，不再只写 1 章。 - **编审 Agent 对照原书后 10 章**：续写完成后调用编审 Agent（`agency_editor_auditor_system`，支持你在工作室自定义的人设），逐章对照原小说后 10 章真实原文，从文笔风格、情节推进、人物口吻、节奏密度、钩子悬念与承接六个维度出具裁决，再做跨章总评（人物弧/冲突升级/线索经营/风格漂移），生成《续写质量分析报告》。 - **报告驱动能力优化**：报告中的低分维度会自动转成下一轮硬性修正——承接失败则强制注入上一章结尾现场锚点（更长窗口），文笔偏低则即使 StyleDNA 已绑定也强制原文风格锚点，钩子/节奏偏低则写入章末钩子与信息密度要求；改进项自动注入下一轮续写指令，形成闭环。 - **报告可视化**：训练报告弹窗新增逐章对比表（沙盒章 / 原书章 / 总分 / 五维 / 承接 / 裁决 / 编审摘要），趋势仍按书聚合、自动跳过评分不可用的轮次。 ### v0.97.0 · Gate 裁决只有一个权威，导航与页面清单同源 - **Gate verdict 不再「run 说完成、gate 说失败」**：`editor_gate_records` 增加 `run_id` 成为 run QC 的唯一权威。后台质检无论先于还是晚于 run 收尾完成，都会把最新裁决回填 `run.result.verdict`；batch 逐章回填，不再长期停在 `pending`。 - **导航不再三份清单**：`navigation/views.ts` 统一分组/label/图标/布局标记，`navigation/viewComponents.tsx` 用 `Record` 强制穷举页面映射；新增视图漏页面会 tsc 失败，不再静默落到 Dashboard。Sidebar 与 App 都从同一份 VIEW 清单派生。 ### v0.96.1 · 日志巡检首轮修复：生成链路状态不再「永远进行中」 每天自动下载用户日志包的分析机器人发现了两处真实问题并修复：生成链路追踪（Tracing 面板）里的运行记录此前从不落终态， 一半以上的记录永远显示「进行中」——现在成功/失败/取消都会正确收尾；保存章节时若遇到已删除或被其它窗口替换的过期章节， 错误提示从「Query returned no rows」改为「目标章节/场景不存在，请刷新目录后重试」，可直接照做。 ### v0.96.0 · 未尽债务收口：租约续期、DB 守卫、保存 CAS、入口互锁 v0.95.0 留下的一批状态机债务已逐项收口： - **租约不再过期失权**：Append/资产租约守卫自带后台续期；进程崩溃留下的过期租约在下次 acquire 前被清理。 - **DB 最后一道防线**：V158 迁移为任务/run/agent task/聊天/审批/gate record 的状态列建触发器，未知状态直接 ABORT，不再静默落库。 - **保存 CAS**：幕前保存携带加载正文的 FNV-1a 指纹；幕后已改正文时拒绝旧快照覆盖，标题/元数据变化不误判。只比对正文，不比对时间戳。 - **入口互锁**：续写与智能输入共享 ref 锁，覆盖意图分类/预检窗口；生成开始后释放，文思 auto-continue 照常。 - **依赖等待显式 waiting**：子任务等父任务不再伪装成 queued；stale 心跳任务在每次派发前被回收。 - **死代码删除**：旧本地 OAuth/JWT session、窗口 closed/hidden 歧义、automation 双 bool、叙事 Falling 不可达、视图布局三处清单。 ### v0.95.0 · 隐式状态机治理：状态只有一个所有者，终态不可被覆盖 全仓审计出 51 个隐式状态机（同一事实散落在多个布尔、Option、字符串列、store 与事件中）。本版把同类回归一次性收口到三个核心边界： - v0.13.0 · 分时介入架构（点击展开） 引入**分时介入架构**，解开 AI 长篇小说创作中「质量与速度不可兼得」的根本矛盾。第一性原理：**把大灾难变成即时可见的小债务。** 蚂蚁搬家，不积巨石。 把「写」和「审」解耦成三条独立时间线： 1. **写作时刻（< 15s 秒出正文）**：`WriteTimeBundle` 只带最小约束（合同红线 + 角色核心 + 场景大纲 + 题材反模式），直连 LLM 单轮生成，立即返回。 2. **审计时刻（后台 30-90s）**：正文返回后，`AuditExecutor` 后台异步跑 7 维 Inspector，问题以 inline 标注回流编辑器，用户当场处理小债。 3. **洞察时刻（每 5 段深度报告）**：`InsightExecutor` 汇总追读力趋势 + 追读债务 + 标注盘点，产出整体健康度报告。 Phase 0 实测（qwen3.6-35b，3 场景 A/B 盲测）：最小约束 vs 全量资产平均质量差距仅 **7.9%**（< 30% 阈值），且会被后台审计追平。证实「慢的根源不是资产量，而是同步链路堆叠的 Inspector / Rewrite」。 设计文档见 [`docs/plans/2026-06-14-time-sliced-intervention-design.md`](./docs/plans/2026-06-14-time-sliced-intervention-design.md)，验收清单见 [`docs/time-sliced-architecture-qa-checklist.md`](./docs/time-sliced-architecture-qa-checklist.md)。
v0.12.0 · 性能重构（点击展开） 针对「智能创作无处不在的卡顿、生成无输出」进行系统性性能重构： 1. **后端生成链路止血**：本地 / 局域网模型默认单候选 + 全局并发限流，候选总超时硬上限 90s；LLM 连接 / 生成超时拆分；上下文准备 SQLite 高频路径 spawn_blocking 化；全局 Mutex 替换为 OnceLock / RwLock。 2. **前端响应与大数据量优化**：生成状态精确显示 + 可靠取消；场景 / 章节分页加载；sync-event 批量失效；文思分析移入 Web Worker；RichTextEditor HTML 序列化节流。 3. **架构级重构**：统一 `generation-status` 事件；知识图谱 viewport 裁剪 + LOD；引入 `tiktoken-rs` 真实 tokenizer 与上下文预算。 修复计划见 [`PERFORMANCE_FIX_PLAN.md`](./PERFORMANCE_FIX_PLAN.md)，阶段验证报告见 `QA-Stage1-report.md`、`QA-Stage2-report.md`、`QA-Stage3-report.md`。
--- ## 📖 用户指南 > 以下基于当前版本实际界面截图整理，持续更新。完整图文版见 [`docs/USER_GUIDE.md`](./docs/USER_GUIDE.md)。 ### 一、产品概览 **草苔 StoryMoss** 将创作流程分为两大空间： | 空间 | 作用 | 适合场景 | | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | | **幕后（Backstage）** | 管理故事、角色、场景、世界观、AI 配置 | 规划、整理素材、配置模型 | | **幕前（Frontstage）** | 沉浸式写作界面，专注正文创作 | 码字、与 AI 对话续写 | 核心思路：幕后把创作要素结构化管好，幕前让你专注写字，AI 在需要时介入，不打断心流。 --- ### Agency 多代理创作（创世 2.0） v0.27.0–v0.30.0 上线的多代理创作框架取代了旧 GenesisPipeline（前端无感，`smart_execute` 创世分支自动切换）： - **主创 LeadWriter**：负责正文创作——首章撰写与逐章续写。 - **管理 Producer**：负责备资产——世界观、角色、大纲、合同等生产资料的准备与落库。 - **编辑审计 EditorAuditor**：负责把关——逐章评审正文，决定是否放行或退回修订。 三代理通过黑板（blackboard）模型并行协作；每章正文经过 **Gate v2 质量门**（code/rule/model/human 四级 grader 加权评分，阈值 0.75）才会交付。系统还具备**持续学习**能力：从创作事件中观察模式，提炼为 instinct，经你确认后晋升为可复用技能——越写越懂你。 在幕前输入"写一部……"即可触发三代理创世，中途可定点取消；侧栏「代理工作室」可实时观看协作过程。 --- ### 二、幕前写作界面 ![幕前写作](docs/product-screenshots/00_frontstage.png) 极简、全屏的写作环境，唯一目的就是让你专注码字。 #### 顶部状态栏 | 元素 | 作用 | | -------- | ---------------------------------- | | **草苔** | 返回幕后 | | **字数** | 当前章节字数 / 总字数 | | **18px** | 当前字号，点击可调 | | **色调** | 十二套传统色（顶栏色点只改幕前；设置里幕前/幕后分列） | | **设置** | 打开设置 / 幕后工作室 | | **温** | 文思模式切换 | #### 中间编辑区 - 点击"开始写作…"即可输入。 - 支持富文本格式。 - 自动保存。 #### 底部 AI 输入栏 - 输入任意指令，例如"帮我续写下一段""把这段改得更紧张""加入一个意外转折"。 - 按回车或点击纸飞机发送。 - 已发送的指令按故事隔离持久保存（最近 20 条），关闭窗口后不丢失；按 ↑/↓ 浏览历史指令，-> 确认填充。 #### 文思模式 点击右上角 **温** 切换 AI 介入程度： - **被动**：只在发指令时响应。 - **主动**：适时给出萤火提示（下一句建议、情节提醒）。 --- ### 三、全局导航 左侧边栏是所有功能的入口，任何页面都可以一键切换。 ![仪表盘](docs/product-screenshots/01_dashboard.png) | 按钮 | 作用 | | ---------------- | ---------------------------- | | **开幕前写作** | 快速打开「幕前写作」窗口 | | **仪表盘** | 回到首页，查看统计与快捷入口 | | **故事** | 管理所有故事项目 | | **代理工作室** | 实时查看三代理协作、黑板与活动时间线 | | **角色** | 管理登场角色与关系 | | **世界构建** | 设定世界观、势力、规则 | | **场景** | 管理场景（情节单元） | | **知识图谱** | 可视化角色/地点/事件关系 | | **技能** | 配置 AI 辅助技能 | | **MCP** | 连接外部模型/工具（在设置 → 扩展） | | **全部任务** | 查看后台 AI 任务队列（任务组） | | **拆书** | 分析参考书籍结构（任务组） | | **指导书提炼** | 上传创作指导书并提炼方法论（任务组） | | **续写训练** | 取原书章节续写并与真实后续章五维对比（任务组） | | **伏笔看板** | 追踪伏笔埋设与回收 | | **叙事分析** | 诊断故事节奏与结构 | | **创作评估** | 质量门评分趋势、检查点对比与 token 用量 | | **学习中心** | 查看与管理 AI 学到的创作模式，确认晋升为技能 | | **Story System** | 高级契约与版本管理 | | **用量统计** | AI 调用与 Token 消耗 | | **写作统计** | 字数、时长、写作习惯 | | **设置** | 模型、账号、通用偏好 | --- ### 四、仪表盘 — 创作起点 ![仪表盘](docs/product-screenshots/01_dashboard.png) 打开应用后首先进入这里。核心元素： - **快捷创建**： - **AI 创建故事** —— 输入一句话创意，AI 生成故事框架（含大纲、角色、场景）。 - **手动创建** —— 自己填写标题、简介、类型，从零开始。 - **统计卡片**：故事数 / 角色数 / 场景数，点击可跳转。 - **GENESIS 运行记录**（历史）：旧版 Genesis 创世流程的运行历史，仅供回顾；v0.27.0 起创世由 Agency 多代理框架执行，实时过程见侧栏「代理工作室」。 - **开始创作引导**：没有故事时，下方会出现"开始你的创作之旅"，提供 AI/手动两种创建入口。 **典型路径**：打开应用 → 仪表盘 → AI 创建故事 → 输入创意 → 进入「故事」页继续完善。 --- ### 五、故事 — 作品管理中心 ![故事页](docs/product-screenshots/02_stories.png) "故事"是创作的顶层容器。一本小说、一个短篇，都是一个故事。 首次使用时页面为空，需要先创建故事。有数据后： - 故事卡片/列表展示标题、类型、进度、最近编辑时间。 - **打开** / **编辑** / **删除** / **导出** 等操作。 选择一个故事后，左侧底部会显示"当前编辑"，角色、场景、世界观等页面自动切换到该故事的数据。 --- ### 六、角色 — 人物资料库 ![角色页](docs/product-screenshots/03_characters.png) 管理系统化的人物设定： - **基本信息**：姓名、性别、年龄、外貌。 - **性格与背景**：性格标签、核心驱动力、出身、目标。 - **关系网络**：与其他角色的关系可视化。 - **AI 生成角色**：输入一句话，AI 扩展成完整人设。 这让 AI 在续写时严格遵循人设，避免"角色崩坏"。 --- ### 七、场景 — 情节单元 ![场景页](docs/product-screenshots/04_scenes.png) "场景"是故事的最小情节单位，类似"一场戏"。 - 场景卡片：标题、所属章节、出场角色、地点、状态。 - **新增 / 编辑 / AI 扩写 / 排序**。 - 把"写一章"拆成"写几场戏"，降低创作心理压力。 --- ### 八、世界构建 — 设定资料库 ![世界构建](docs/product-screenshots/05_world_building.png) 存放世界观、势力、地理、规则等背景设定。支持分类浏览、AI 生成世界观、关联角色/场景。 保证奇幻/科幻/架空作品的设定不自相矛盾，防止 AI "吃书"。 --- ### 九、知识图谱 — 关系可视化 ![知识图谱](docs/product-screenshots/06_knowledge-graph.png) 把角色、地点、事件、势力变成一张可交互网络图： - 拖拽节点、缩放画布。 - 点击节点查看详情。 - 筛选显示某类节点。 - **手动 CRUD**：图例面板可新建实体，实体详情面板可添加关系。 直观发现"谁太久没出场""哪条线索忘了回收"。 --- ### 十、技能工坊 — AI 辅助技能 ![技能页](docs/product-screenshots/07_skills.png) 管理和配置可复用的 AI 技能模板： - **导入技能**：导入别人分享的技能配置。 - **分类筛选**：全部 / 写作 / 分析 / 角色 / 情节 / 风格 / 世界观 / 导出 / 集成 / 自定义。 - **技能卡片**：名称、描述、适用场景、启用开关。 在幕前写作时，可随时调用已启用的技能（如"续写""润色""生成大纲"）。 --- ### 十一、MCP — 外部工具连接 ![MCP](docs/product-screenshots/08_mcp.png) MCP（Model Context Protocol）让草苔连接外部模型或数据源，扩展 AI 能力。例如连接专门的"古文润色"模型或私有知识库。 --- ### 十二、拆书 — 学习经典结构 ![拆书](docs/product-screenshots/09_book-deconstruction.png) 上传参考小说，AI 自动分析： - 整体结构（三幕式、英雄之旅等） - 章节节奏与高潮分布 - 角色出场频率 - 核心主题 把"凭感觉写"变成"有参照地写"。 --- ### 十三、任务 — 后台作业队列 ![任务页](docs/product-screenshots/10_tasks.png) 当 AI 执行批量操作（批量润色、整书生成）时，会在这里显示进度。 - **状态筛选**：全部 / 执行中 / 等待中 / 已完成 / 失败。 - **新建任务**：手动发起后台 AI 任务。 你可以关闭界面去做别的事，回来在任务页查看结果。 --- ### 十四、伏笔看板 — 线索回收 ![伏笔看板](docs/product-screenshots/11_foreshadowing.png) 管理伏笔的全生命周期： - **已埋下 / 已回收 / 待回收 / 废弃** 四态看板。 - 创建伏笔时填写描述、预期回收章节、重要性。 - 关联到具体场景。 防止"开头精彩、结尾烂尾"，确保每条线索都有交代。 --- ### 十五、叙事分析 — 结构诊断 ![叙事分析](docs/product-screenshots/12_narrative-analysis.png) 用 AI 诊断故事的叙事健康度： - 节奏曲线（每章紧张度变化） - 角色戏份分布 - 情节密度（对话/动作/描写比例） - AI 诊断建议 像给小说做体检，发现结构问题再针对性修改。 --- ### 十六、Story System — 高级契约系统 ![Story System](docs/product-screenshots/13_story-system.png) 高级用户功能： - **契约树**：定义 AI 必须遵守的规则（如"主角不能死""保持第三人称"）；树中的 **VOLUME 合同**即长篇的卷纲（卷目标 / 卷末高潮 / 须兑现伏笔），可在「运行维护 → 卷纲」规划。 - **版本记录**：类似 Git 的提交历史，可回溯故事版本。 - **运行时规则**：控制 AI 生成的行为边界。 让 AI 在长篇幅创作中保持高度一致性。 --- ### 十七、用量统计与写作统计 ![用量统计](docs/product-screenshots/14_usage-stats.png) **用量统计**：AI 调用次数、Token 消耗、按模型/功能拆分。适合关注 API 成本的用户。 ![写作统计](docs/product-screenshots/15_writing-stats.png) **写作统计**：每日字数、活跃时段、连续创作天数、平均写作速度。帮助你建立稳定输出节奏。 --- ### 十八、设置 — 模型与偏好 ![设置页](docs/product-screenshots/16_settings.png) 配置 AI 模型和应用偏好： - **模型管理**：添加、删除、测试 LLM 连接（聊天/嵌入/多模态/图像）。 - **Agent 配置**：为不同 AI Agent 分配模型。 - **创作方法论**：选择雪花法、英雄之旅等创作框架。 - **工作流**：配置自动化流程。 - **通用设置**：主题、语言、自动保存、字号、行高。 - **数据统计**：查看本地功能使用统计。 - **账号与登录**：管理账号和订阅。 **首次使用建议**：进入 **模型管理** → **添加聊天模型** → 填写 API 地址和 Key → 测试连接 → 完成后即可在幕前调用 AI。 #### 提示词注册表（v0.19.0 新增） 进入 **设置 → 提示词** 可查看和编辑全部 35+ 个 AI 提示词： - **分类浏览**：15 个分类折叠面板（写作核心 / 审校 / 评点 / 规划 / 分析 / 世界观 / 角色 / 叙事 / 方法论 / 技能 / 记忆 / 知识 / 探测 / 系统 / 其他） - **实时搜索**：按提示词 ID、名称、描述或内容关键词搜索 - **编辑覆盖**：点击任意提示词展开编辑器，修改后保存即可覆盖默认提示词 - **默认值预览**：已覆盖的提示词显示内置默认值（只读），方便对比修改 - **批量重置**：一键恢复所有提示词到默认状态 - **模板变量**：提示词中 `{{variable}}` 形式的变量会自动高亮 所有修改即时生效，下次 AI 调用自动使用新提示词。 --- ### 十九、快速上手 第一次使用草苔，建议按以下顺序： 1. 打开应用 → 看到仪表盘。 2. 点击 **AI 创建故事** → 输入创意一句话 → 三代理协作创世：管理备资产、主创作首章、编辑审计把关（中途可取消）。 3. 打开侧栏 **代理工作室** → 实时观察三代理的分工、黑板与活动时间线。 4. 进入「故事」页 → 确认新建的故事。 5. 进入「角色」页 → 添加 2-3 个核心角色。 6. 进入「场景」页 → 创建第一章的关键场景。 7. 点击左侧 **开幕前写作** → 在幕前界面写第一章。 8. 卡壳时用底部 AI 输入栏求助。 9. 返回幕后「叙事分析」查看结构诊断。 --- ### 二十、常见状态 - **顶部红色提示条"无法连接到本地服务"**：表示前端未连上后端。请等待几秒后点击"重试"，或重启应用。 - **左下角"登录"**：未登录状态，点击可登录账号。 - **右上角更新通知**：有新版本时弹出，可选择安装或忽略。 --- ### 二十一、运行维护 · 创作评估 · 学习中心（幕后三页） **运行维护**（侧栏「运维」组）集中呈现四类「待你决策」的队列与一处计划入口： - **质量债**：质检降级 / 未解决的问题（含建议回收窗口），可结清或忽略。 - **待确认**：分析自动新增的世界观硬规则，确认后才作为硬约束。 - **文风偏好**：从你手改中提炼的文风规则（可停用 / 启用）。 - **成本**：按故事聚合的调用与 token + 计费盲区告警。 - **物料重算**：编辑旧章后受影响的章节摘要 / 分层摘要 / 快照（自动重算，可手动触发）；**章纲待重规划**在这里——新旧对照默认全不勾选，你勾选哪条落库哪条。 - **卷纲**：为长篇规划每一卷（卷目标 / 卷末高潮 / 须兑现伏笔 / 线索预算）；写到卷末会提示规划下一卷。 **创作评估**：质量门通过率、Gate 加权分趋势、判定历史、检查点对比、**判官一致率**（编辑每条阻断意见的引用在你成稿里被删/被改写 = 采纳；总采纳率 + 每章明细，附你的修改率对照）与 token 用量。 **学习中心**：已学模式与置信度、晋升提案（确认后物化为技能）、观察流、**章法偏好**（每拍写作手法的接受 / 放弃统计，样本 ≥5 条才影响选择，可重置）与「立即分析」。 --- ## 🏗️ 技术栈 - **前端**：React 18 + TypeScript 5.8 + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS 3 - **桌面框架**：Tauri 2.4（Rust 后端 + Web 前端） - **编辑器**：TipTap / ProseMirror - **状态管理**：Zustand + TanStack Query - **知识图谱**：ReactFlow - **向量存储**：LanceDB + SQLite - **LLM 适配**：OpenAI / Anthropic / Ollama / 自定义本地 API - **提示词注册表**（v0.19.0）：35+ 内置提示词统一注册表，15 分类，前端完整管理，运行时覆盖生效 - **分时介入架构**（v0.13.0）：三条时间线（写作/审计/洞察）解耦，解开质量与速度矛盾 - **Agency 多代理创作框架**（v0.27.0–v0.30.0）：主创/管理/编辑审计三代理黑板并行协作，Gate v2 四级 grader 加权评分质量门，角色×任务模型路由，会话快照跨会话恢复，持续学习双轨（观察 → instinct → 晋升技能），IPC 命令族 `agency_*` - **PROBLEM 七元素框架**（v0.30.22）：基于 Erik Bork 的 PROBLEM 七元素（Punishing/Relatable/Original/Believable/Life-Altering/Entertaining/Meaningful）将简单指令自动增强为强力 Logline（谁 + 催化事件 + 核心不可能的任务 + 失败后果），驱动故事大纲生成并注入续写上下文，新增可编辑提示词 `agency_problem_logline` / `agency_problem_outline` - **Context Rot 显式防御**（v0.25.0）：`ContextPrioritizer` 按 Critical/High/Normal/Background 排序系统提示词，并在结尾双重锚定关键约束，缓解长上下文中的 "Lost in the Middle" - **四级错误分类与恢复**（v0.25.0）：`ErrorSeverity` Fatal/Retry/Degraded/UserAction + 指数退避重试 + 降级回退 + `AgentInterruptionModal` 显式中断 UI --- ## 📚 更多文档 | 文档 | 说明 | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ | | [`docs/USER_GUIDE.md`](./docs/USER_GUIDE.md) | 完整用户指南（含全部截图与详细说明） | | [`CHANGELOG.md`](./CHANGELOG.md) | 版本更新日志 | | [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](./ARCHITECTURE.md) | 系统架构设计（含分时介入架构章节） | | [`docs/plans/2026-06-14-time-sliced-intervention-design.md`](./docs/plans/2026-06-14-time-sliced-intervention-design.md) | 分时架构设计文档（Phase 0 已验证） | | [`docs/time-sliced-architecture-qa-checklist.md`](./docs/time-sliced-architecture-qa-checklist.md) | 分时架构 QA 验收清单 | | [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) | 开发代理指南 | --- ## 📸 截图清单 所有界面截图均由 CDP 自动截取，保存在 [`docs/product-screenshots/`](./docs/product-screenshots/)： | 文件名 | 页面 | | ---------------------------- | ------------ | | `00_frontstage.png` | 幕前写作 | | `01_dashboard.png` | 仪表盘 | | `02_stories.png` | 故事 | | `03_characters.png` | 角色 | | `04_scenes.png` | 场景 | | `05_world_building.png` | 世界构建 | | `06_knowledge-graph.png` | 知识图谱 | | `07_skills.png` | 技能工坊 | | `08_mcp.png` | MCP | | `09_book-deconstruction.png` | 拆书 | | `10_tasks.png` | 任务 | | `11_foreshadowing.png` | 伏笔看板 | | `12_narrative-analysis.png` | 叙事分析 | | `13_story-system.png` | Story System | | `14_usage-stats.png` | 用量统计 | | `15_writing-stats.png` | 写作统计 | | `16_settings.png` | 设置 | --- ## 🤝 参与贡献 欢迎通过 Issue 和 Pull Request 参与项目。大型改动建议先阅读 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) 和 [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](./ARCHITECTURE.md)。 ---

items.readme_text:
### skillsaw **Keep your skills sharp.** A linter for the files that steer AI coding agents.
[![PyPI version](https://badge.fury.io/py/skillsaw.svg)](https://pypi.org/project/skillsaw/) [![PyPI Downloads](https://img.shields.io/pypi/dm/skillsaw)](https://pypi.org/project/skillsaw/) [![Tests](https://github.com/stbenjam/skillsaw/workflows/Tests/badge.svg)](https://github.com/stbenjam/skillsaw/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/stbenjam/skillsaw/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/stbenjam/skillsaw) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/license/Apache-2.0)
skillsaw covers skills, plugins, instruction files (`CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`), hooks, and MCP configs. It checks their structure across every major agent ecosystem, flags supply-chain risks, and reviews their content against research and frontier-lab guidance. Safe fixes can be applied automatically; everything else comes with guidance an agent can act on. See the [supported ecosystems](https://skillsaw.org/repo-types/). **[Get started](https://skillsaw.org/getting-started/)** | **[Browse the rules](https://skillsaw.org/rules/)** | **[Read the documentation](https://skillsaw.org/)** ## See it work [Watch an AI agent grade, fix, and configure a repository from scratch.](https://asciinema.org/a/1259880) [![Watch the skillsaw onboarding demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stbenjam/skillsaw/main/images/onboarding-demo.png)](https://asciinema.org/a/1259880) ## Try it Paste this into your coding agent to onboard skillsaw now: ```text Read and follow the instructions at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stbenjam/skillsaw/refs/heads/main/skills/skillsaw-onboard/SKILL.md to onboard this repo to skillsaw. ``` Or install the onboarding skill for regular use (recommended). Run this from the repository you want to lint: ```bash npx skills add stbenjam/skillsaw ``` Select **`skillsaw-onboard`** and your coding agent, then ask the agent to use that skill to onboard the repo. See [Onboard with AI](https://skillsaw.org/getting-started/#onboard-with-ai) for plugin installation alternatives. Or run it yourself. No installation is required with [`uvx`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/tools/): ```bash uvx skillsaw tree # See what skillsaw detects uvx skillsaw # Lint the current repository uvx skillsaw fix # Apply safe, deterministic fixes uvx skillsaw baseline # Accept existing findings and fail only on new ones ``` ## What it catches - **Multi-ecosystem structure & compatibility:** schema, frontmatter, and manifest validation for Agent Skills (`SKILL.md`), Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (project config, plugins & marketplaces), Cursor plugins & marketplaces, Grok Build (project config, plugins & marketplaces), Z.ai ZCode (`.zcode/` agents, commands, skills and `config.json` hooks & MCP, plugins & marketplaces), Google Antigravity (configuration in any customization root — `.agents/`, `.agent/`, `_agents/`, `_agent/` — its `rules/` and `agents/` prose, plugins, hooks, MCP servers and registries), Agent Plugins (`plugin.json`, `mcp.json`, and the 1.1.0 portable `hooks.json`), GitHub Copilot & VS Code custom agents (`.github/agents/`), OpenCode configuration, Pi packages and project resources, native OpenClaw plugins (including optional theme and artwork declarations), APM packages, MCP server maps, and MCP Registry metadata. - **Content quality & token economy:** research-backed rules detecting instruction drift across duplicate files, excessive instruction budgets, cognitive overload, section length violations, weak language, contradictions, and repetitive inline tool-call examples. - **Discovery & repository integrity:** unreferenced bundled files, broken internal file references, inconsistent terminology, missing stop conditions, and stale baselines. - **Security & supply chain:** - **Dangerous lifecycle hooks:** blocks arbitrary remote code execution, download-and-execute (`curl | sh`, `wget | bash`), and script obfuscation (`eval`) in `hooks.json` and settings. - **Prohibited & unvetted MCP servers:** enforces strict MCP allowlists across root, plugin, and custom agent configurations. - **Prompt injection & stealth payloads:** detects invisible Unicode (ASCII smuggling, zero-width tags, bidi overrides), high-entropy encoded payloads (base64/hex), and hidden instructions in comments and code fences. - **Environment & context security:** flags dangerous environment overrides (`LD_PRELOAD`, `NODE_OPTIONS`, `PYTHONPATH`), unallowlisted dynamic context injection, and embedded credentials. - **Deterministic autofixes:** safe, instant automated fixes for invalid frontmatter, broken headings, missing manifests, unclosed code fences, and schema keys via `skillsaw fix`. skillsaw detects repository types automatically and lints multiple formats in the same project. See [supported repository types](https://skillsaw.org/repo-types/) and the [complete rule reference](https://skillsaw.org/rules/) for details. Pi packages and `.pi/` project resources are supported, including native skills, prompt templates, manifest globs, local package references, and first-party `.pi/mcp.json` servers. Shared MCP credential and policy checks cover these servers; enable `pi-mcp-valid` for Pi 1.5 field validation, including `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl`, and `pi-settings-schema` to check `.pi/settings.json` against Pi's published 1.5.0 settings schema. See [Pi configuration checks](https://skillsaw.org/rules/pi-config-valid/), [Pi settings schema checks](https://skillsaw.org/rules/pi-settings-schema/), and [Pi MCP checks](https://skillsaw.org/rules/pi-mcp-valid/). ## Built for real workflows skillsaw works locally, in CI, and inside coding-agent workflows. It provides line-level findings, explanations for every rule, deterministic autofixes, baselines for gradual adoption, GitHub and GitLab integration, and text, JSON, SARIF, HTML, and Code Climate output. Rules are configurable, and projects can add local rules or install rule plugins. Typo'd or wrong-typed rule options in `.skillsaw.yaml` are reported with did-you-mean suggestions instead of being silently ignored. | Goal | Documentation | | --- | --- | | Install and run skillsaw | [Getting Started](https://skillsaw.org/getting-started/) | | Tune rules and exclusions | [Configuration](https://skillsaw.org/configuration/) | | Adopt it without fixing everything at once | [Baselines](https://skillsaw.org/baseline/) | | Review the security model | [Supply Chain Protection](https://skillsaw.org/supply-chain-protection/) | | Supported ecosystems and tools | [Repository Types](https://skillsaw.org/repo-types/) | | Add checks to pull requests & CI | [CI Integration](https://skillsaw.org/ci/) | | Compare with `claude plugin validate` | [Claude Code validator overlap](https://skillsaw.org/claude-validate/) | | See diagnostics in VS Code | [VS Code extension](editors/vscode/README.md) and [publisher onboarding](examples/editor-onboarding/README.md) | | Understand and apply fixes | [Autofixing](https://skillsaw.org/autofixing/) | | Convert plugins to Agent Plugins v1 | [Porting to Agent Plugins](https://skillsaw.org/porting/) | | Create project-specific checks | [Custom Rules](https://skillsaw.org/custom-rules/) | | Publish reusable rule packages | [Rule Plugins](https://skillsaw.org/plugins/) | | Inspect the typed parse tree | [Lint Tree](https://skillsaw.org/lint-tree/) | | Explain Codex instruction selection and its cumulative byte cap | [Codex project instructions](https://skillsaw.org/rules/codex-project-instructions/) | | Look up commands and flags | [CLI Reference](https://skillsaw.org/cli/) | | Feed the docs to an AI agent | [llms.txt](https://skillsaw.org/llms.txt) index, [llms-full.txt](https://skillsaw.org/llms-full.txt) full docs | Updating from 0.20? See the [0.21 upgrade guide](https://skillsaw.org/upgrading-0.21/) for removed commands and rules, new opt-in checks, and Pi skill validation. Codex portable plugins can place OpenAI metadata and hooks in `plugin.json` under `extensions.com.openai`. Skillsaw follows that overlay's precedence over `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, validates its declared resources, and checks portable `skills/` and `mcp.json` through the Agent Plugins rules. The optional `extensions.com.openai.onboardingSkill` must reference a bundled skill's `SKILL.md`, relative to the plugin root (with or without `./`). The [manifest rule](https://skillsaw.org/rules/codex-plugin-json-valid/) checks its type, effective skill membership, and containment, including symlink escapes. Project `.codex/config.toml` files also get a [targeted warning](https://skillsaw.org/rules/codex-mcp-headers/) when an HTTP MCP server uses the ignored `headers` field instead of `http_headers` or `env_http_headers`. ## Measure the result Every run produces a letter grade based on weighted violation density. The same data can be rendered as a self-contained report card for a README or project dashboard. *skillsaw's own report card, generated with `skillsaw badge --large`.* Learn how to generate a [grade badge and report card](https://skillsaw.org/cli/#skillsaw-badge) for your project. ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the project guidelines and [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md) for the local setup. Questions and bug reports belong in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/stbenjam/skillsaw/issues). For a shareable diagnostic bundle, run `skillsaw feedback` in the affected repository and review the ZIP before attaching it to an issue. Files selected with `--include` or `--config` are copied verbatim, including BOMs and line endings. Selections default to 4 MiB per file and 16 MiB total across distinct ZIP members; use positive byte values with `--max-file-bytes` and `--max-total-bytes` to override these limits. An oversized selection stops before diagnostic lint and creates no bundle. These limits cover selected file bytes only, not diagnostic output or total process memory. skillsaw is licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). ## Thank you to our contributors skillsaw is better because people contribute code, bug reports, and ideas. Thank you!
Contributors

@cgwalters @ehelms @EmilienM @jeffreylo
@jfchevrette @kannon92 @nyechiel @rajusem
@skyth3r @stbenjam @tchughesiv @tyraziel

items.name: everruns
items.description: Open source Rust framework and durable runtime for AI agents. MIT
items.readme_text:
# Everruns [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-everruns.com-blue)](https://everruns.com) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-everruns.com%2Fdocs-green)](https://everruns.com/docs) [![Crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/everruns.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/everruns) [![CI](https://github.com/everruns/everruns/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/everruns/everruns/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Repo: Agent Friendly](https://img.shields.io/badge/Repo-Agent%20Friendly-blue)](AGENTS.md) **Build capable AI agents in Rust. Run them on your own machines.** Everruns is an open-source framework and durable runtime for AI agents in Rust. Define agents, attach models and typed tools, run multi-turn sessions, and observe execution through one application-facing API. It is a free, non-commercial project by [Mykhailo Chalyi](https://chaliy.name) and contributors, pre-1.0, and part of the [Everruns community ecosystem](https://everruns.com/projects/) of open-source AI projects. There is no company behind it and no paid edition. Talk to us on [Discord](https://everruns.com/discord/everruns). Use the framework in your application. When you need a shared runtime, run the Everruns platform yourself on your machine, a server or Kubernetes. [Build with the framework](https://everruns.com/docs/framework/quickstart/) · [Run it yourself](https://everruns.com/docs/getting-started/introduction/#self-hosted) · [Read the docs](https://everruns.com/docs/framework/)

## Build an agent Add the application-facing crate: ```bash cargo add everruns --features openai cargo add tokio --features macros,rt-multi-thread export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... ``` Then define a typed tool, give it to an agent, and run a turn: ```rust use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH}; use everruns::{Agent, Engine, OpenAI}; #[everruns::tool] async fn current_time() -> Result { let seconds = SystemTime::now() .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH) .map_err(|error| error.to_string())? .as_secs(); Ok(format!("{seconds} seconds since the Unix epoch")) } #[tokio::main] async fn main() -> Result<(), Box> { let agent = Agent::builder() .name("assistant") .instructions("Use current_time when asked about time. Be concise.") .provider(OpenAI::from_env()?) .model("gpt-6.2-sol") .tool(current_time()) .build()?; let session = Engine::new().create(agent); let turn = session.send_and_wait("What time is it?").await?; println!("{}", turn.response); Ok(()) } ``` Everruns derives the tool schema from the Rust function, lets the model call it during the turn, and returns the result before producing the final response. [Continue the framework quickstart.](https://everruns.com/docs/framework/quickstart/) > **Note:** Everruns is under active development. Expect rapid changes and experimental features. ## The agent framework The [`everruns`](./crates/everruns) crate keeps the application-facing agent loop explicit and embeddable: - **Agents and sessions** — describe an agent once, then create independent, multi-turn conversations through an `Engine`. - **Models and providers** — start offline, use OpenAI, or attach a custom provider without coupling application code to a closed provider enum. - **Typed tools and capabilities** — give agents function tools and opt into filesystem, shell, web, Lua, and MCP boundaries deliberately. - **Events, cancellation, and lifecycle hooks** — observe a live turn, add application behavior at execution boundaries, and stop work cooperatively. - **Persistence and execution choices** — begin with engine-lifetime memory, add local crash-durable state, or cross deliberately into a distributed host. [Framework overview](https://everruns.com/docs/framework/) ## Choose how you run Everruns | Framework | Self-hosted platform | | --- | --- | | Start here. Embed Everruns in the Rust application you are building; you own the process, deployment, integrations, and data path.

[Framework quickstart →](https://everruns.com/docs/framework/quickstart/) | Run the shared runtime in infrastructure you manage when you need a control plane, server, workers, UI, remote API, and durable execution.

[On your machine →](https://everruns.com/docs/getting-started/run-locally/) · [Docker Compose →](https://everruns.com/docs/getting-started/docker-compose/) · [Kubernetes →](https://everruns.com/docs/getting-started/kubernetes/) · [Architecture →](https://everruns.com/docs/explanation/architecture/) | ### Set it up with your agent Give your coding agent the Everruns skill. It covers the Framework, installing and running your own Everruns, and building, running, debugging and shipping agents on it: ```bash npx skills add everruns/everruns ``` Then ask for what you want, for example: ```text Install Everruns on this machine with Docker and sign me in. ``` ```text Add an Everruns agent with a typed tool to this Rust project and run it once. ``` The same skill comes with the [Everruns plugin](https://github.com/everruns/plugins) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI, and with the CLI (`everruns agent-skill install`). Without installing anything, add `Instructions: https://everruns.com/.well-known/agent-skills/everruns/SKILL.md` to the prompt. No server to spare? Look around the [demo instance](https://app.everruns.com) ([quickstart](https://everruns.com/docs/getting-started/cloud/)). It runs the same open-source code and is a demo, not a hosted service. ### Platform capabilities The Platform, self-hosted or on the demo instance, adds durable execution, a stateless worker pool, a web UI, and a remote API. It also publishes agents to Slack, web chat, A2A, webhooks, schedules, voice, HTTP, and MCP; manages organizations and permissions; and supports observation, budgeting, and evaluation. [Platform capabilities](https://everruns.com/docs/features/capabilities/) · [Channels](https://everruns.com/docs/features/channels/) · [Durable execution](https://everruns.com/docs/explanation/durable-execution/) · [Observability](https://everruns.com/docs/observability/) ## How can I support this project? Everruns is a free, non-commercial community project. There are many ways to help: - Use Everruns and tell us how it went on [Discord](https://everruns.com/discord/everruns) or by email ([mykhailo@everruns.com](mailto:mykhailo@everruns.com)) - Take one of the [open research questions](https://everruns.com/research/) and share what you measured - Report bugs and rough edges in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/everruns/everruns/issues) - Star the repository, it helps other people find it - Write a blog post or share the agent you built - Help with the [documentation](https://everruns.com/docs/) by asking questions or sending PRs - Contribute code (see below, and say hi on [Discord](https://everruns.com/discord/everruns)) - Talk about Everruns around you ## Documentation Full documentation lives at **[everruns.com/docs](https://everruns.com/docs)**. - [Everruns Framework](https://everruns.com/docs/framework/) — build and run agents inside a Rust application - [Framework quickstart](https://everruns.com/docs/framework/quickstart/) — install the crate and configure a provider - [Run on your machine](https://everruns.com/docs/getting-started/run-locally/) — `everruns docker up` starts the full Platform in Docker - [Docker Compose](https://everruns.com/docs/getting-started/docker-compose/) and [Kubernetes](https://everruns.com/docs/getting-started/kubernetes/) — run it on a server or a cluster - [How-to guides](https://everruns.com/docs/how-to/) — give agents tools, stream events, publish to Slack, and enforce budgets - [API reference](https://everruns.com/docs/api/) — OpenAPI 3.0 - [SDKs](https://everruns.com/docs/features/sdk/) — Rust, Python, and TypeScript clients - [Docs as text](https://everruns.com/docs/llms.txt) — `llms.txt` index, per-topic Markdown sets, and the OpenAPI schema for agents ## Security Everruns runs untrusted agent and tool code for multiple tenants, so security is a core design goal. Threats are tracked with stable IDs across authentication, tenant isolation, permissions, tool execution, LLM integration, sandboxes, durable execution, and channel integrations, each with a documented mitigation and, where feasible, test coverage. - [Threat model](./knowledge/security/threat-model.md) — full analysis, mitigation status, and accepted risks - [Security testing](./knowledge/security/security-testing.md) — threat-model tests, failure injection, DeepSec scanning, and supply-chain checks - [Security policy](./SECURITY.md) — report a vulnerability ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for local development setup and [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) for the conventions used by both human and AI contributors. ## License MIT

items.name: hush
items.description: Quieter sessions for Claude Code: less narration, shorter tool output and concise answers focused on the result.
items.readme_text:
Hush

Every answer in the shape you choose.

Available on


Claude Code, primary host
Codex
Antigravity

Hush has no Codex package and no Antigravity package.

Get started · What is this? · How it works · What you can do · Evidence

## What is this? Hush is a plugin for Claude Code, an AI coding assistant. It runs on Claude Code only. It gives every answer the same shape, and you set that shape. You ask the assistant to fix a failing test. It reads files, runs commands and explains each step. When it finishes, the result is somewhere in the scroll. With Hush the steps fold away. One message comes at the end. It holds the same parts in the same order: what happened, why, what did not pass, and what to do next.

*Ember is the mascot of the Foundry plugins. The scene is an illustration, not a measurement.* **You ask:** "The login test fails. Fix it." **You get:** one message at the end, shaped like this. It is the voice's own example, shortened. A recorded session is under [The numbers](#the-numbers). ```text **The login test passes again. The token check compared text with a number.** --- `verifyToken` read the expiry as text, so every token looked expired. I changed one line, auth.js:58, to read it as a number. `npm test` passes: 212 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. I did not try a real login in the browser. --- **Next:** open auth.js:58 and read the one-line change. ``` ## Why you'd want it - **Yours to shape.** `/hush:config` sets the length, the parts and the layout. Pick a preset, or describe what you want in your own words. - **Steps folded, not lost.** A 300 KB log becomes a short digest, and the full copy stays on your machine. - **A shape you can count on.** The result comes first, in one bold line. Steps come numbered. Things with the same fields come as a table. - **A floor no setting removes.** A blocker, a failed check and an unverified claim always stay. ## How it works Hush has three parts. All run on your machine, and nothing is sent anywhere. | Part | What it does | | --- | --- | | The voice | An output style, which is Claude Code's name for a writing style. It asks the assistant for one message at the end of the work. It gives each kind of content its form. | | The trims | Hooks, which are small programs Claude Code runs at set moments. These run when a command finishes. They shorten long output and keep every warning, error and failure line. | | The fold | An optional mod for the Claude desktop app. It folds a finished turn's progress texts into one line. One press shows them again. | A shortened view says so in square brackets. Very large output is saved to a file, so the assistant can read the rest. Read [how Hush works](docs/knowledge/how-it-works.md) for each trim, its limits and where saved output goes. ## What you can do | You want to | What you get | | --- | --- | | Choose how much you read | `/hush:config` and one of four presets, from `minimal` to `explainer` | | Set one part at a time | 14 settings: the length, the sentence length, where the next step goes, emoji cues and more | | Describe it in your own words | `/hush:config only the result and the next step` | | See your choice before you save it | A configurator with a sample message, in the Claude desktop app | | See output that was shortened | A reference to the saved full copy, where one exists | | Get a long explanation | Ask for one. A request to explain lifts the length limit for that answer | | Pause the voice for one session | Send `hush off`. Send `hush on` to bring it back | | Turn off part of Hush | One environment variable per part, listed on [Hush settings](docs/knowledge/settings.md) | | Show how much Hush kept out | A count you can read from your own status line script; see [the saved count](docs/knowledge/how-it-works.md#the-saved-count) |

The picture is the configurator's own sample message, not a recorded session. ### Settings Most people never change a setting. These three are the ones people reach for: | Setting | Values | What it does | | --- | --- | --- | | `/hush:config` | A command | Shapes the last message. Its presets are `standard`, `minimal`, `explainer` and `terminal`. | | `HUSH_DISABLE` | `1` | Stops the trims, the pause switch and the subagent brief. The voice stays on until you disable or uninstall the plugin. | | `HUSH_WRAP` | `1` | Lets Hush trim the output of failing commands too. It is not safe with scoped allow rules such as `Bash(node*)`. | No setting removes a blocker, a pending approval, an unverified claim or anything left unchecked. [Hush settings](docs/knowledge/settings.md) lists every variable, preset and message setting. ## Install ### Claude Code You need Claude Code 2.1.323 or later, and Node.js 22 or later. Inside Claude Code, run: ```text /plugin marketplace add V-Songbird/foundry /plugin install hush@foundry ``` Then start a new session. To check that it worked, run `claude plugin list` in a terminal. The list names `hush`. Then run `/hush:config` inside Claude Code: the configurator opens, or its questions start in a terminal. Hush names Claude Code 2.1.323 in its manifest. An older Claude Code may still install it, and Hush is not tested there. ### Update In Claude Code, run these. Then start a new session: ```text /plugin marketplace update foundry /plugin update hush@foundry ``` ## Good to know | Limit | What it means for you | | --- | --- | | A short answer can leave out a detail | Correctness comes before brevity. Ask for depth when you need it, and check the result before you act on it. | | Hush is not a token saver | The voice rides in every request. On Claude Opus 5.5, Hush sessions cost 9% more on average. The current voice has no measured cost. See [The numbers](#the-numbers). | | The shape is asked for, not enforced | The assistant follows the voice most of the time, not always. [The numbers](#the-numbers) say how often. | | The voice takes the one output style slot | To use another output style in Claude Code, disable or uninstall Hush. | | Saved output is temporary | Hush deletes it when the session ends. On Windows, treat the saved files as readable by anything that runs as you. | | The desktop mod is optional | It draws only in the Claude desktop app. No rendered check of it is published. | ## The numbers Each figure comes from recorded test sessions. The figures describe those runs, not yours, and results vary between runs. Each test session is a real Claude Code session in its own throwaway folder. Every job ends with a check, and a short answer that breaks the job counts as a failure. ### Claude Code results This batch ran on September 28, 2026 with Claude Opus 5.5 at the default effort. It has nine jobs and four runs per setup, so 36 sessions each. It measures the voice of release [1.13.0](https://github.com/V-Songbird/hush/releases/tag/v1.13.0). The current voice has no measured result. | Model | Setup | Jobs right | Spoke at most once before the answer | Median final prose words | Average bill per session | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Claude Opus 5.5 | No plugin | 36/36 | 28/36 | 369 | $0.421 | | Claude Opus 5.5 | hush | 36/36 | 36/36 | 271 | $0.458 |

Both setups got all 36 jobs right. Hush said nothing before the answer in 34 of 36 sessions, against 12 of 36 without a plugin. That voice asked the assistant to write nothing between steps. The current voice does not ask for that, so expect progress notes while it works. In the Claude desktop app, the fold hides them once the answer arrives. The same batch shows how the shape held:

| What was checked | With Hush | No plugin | | --- | --- | --- | | A fresh reader could say what happened, what to open and what to do next | 100% of answers | 94.4% | | The answer linked the file with a line number | 29 of 36 | 0 of 36 | | Words sitting in blocks over 40 words | 52.3% | 78.3% | | Sentences over 20 words | 0.5% | 10.9% | The shape is not perfect. Half of Hush's words still sat in long blocks. **On Opus 5.5, Hush costs more.** The average bill per session was 9% higher. Seven of the nine jobs cost more, by 4% to 32%. Only the two jobs that print the most came out cheaper.
Watch the recorded demo: the same job with and without Hush, on Claude Opus 5.5 Hush's answer is the longer one, 206 words against 179. It opens with the result and names the line that changed.

[Hush benchmarks](docs/knowledge/benchmarks.md) has the method, a second batch on Claude Opus 5, and every place Hush loses. ## Going deeper [How Hush works](docs/knowledge/how-it-works.md) · [Hush settings](docs/knowledge/settings.md) · [Hush benchmarks](docs/knowledge/benchmarks.md) Release notes are on the [Hush releases page](https://github.com/V-Songbird/hush/releases). [Foundry](https://github.com/V-Songbird/foundry) lists the whole family. Report a bug or ask a question on [Hush's issue tracker](https://github.com/V-Songbird/hush/issues). Report a vulnerability as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) says. To change Hush, read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## License MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

items.name: agentty
items.description: Agentic Development Environment (ADE) in your terminal

Agentty ADE

![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/agentty) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/agentty-xyz/agentty/graph/badge.svg?token=YRGKGTM0HP)](https://codecov.io/gh/agentty-xyz/agentty) [![Postsubmit](https://github.com/agentty-xyz/agentty/actions/workflows/postsubmit.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/agentty-xyz/agentty/actions/workflows/postsubmit.yml) [![Quality gate status](https://sonarcloud.io/api/project_badges/measure?project=agentty-xyz_agentty&metric=alert_status)](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=agentty-xyz_agentty) [![Bugs](https://sonarcloud.io/api/project_badges/measure?project=agentty-xyz_agentty&metric=bugs)](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=agentty-xyz_agentty) [![Code Smells](https://sonarcloud.io/api/project_badges/measure?project=agentty-xyz_agentty&metric=code_smells)](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=agentty-xyz_agentty) [![Duplicated Lines (%)](https://sonarcloud.io/api/project_badges/measure?project=agentty-xyz_agentty&metric=duplicated_lines_density)](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=agentty-xyz_agentty) [![Coverage](https://sonarcloud.io/api/project_badges/measure?project=agentty-xyz_agentty&metric=coverage)](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=agentty-xyz_agentty) Agentty is an **ADE (Agentic Development Environment) for structured, controllable AI-assisted software development**. Built with Rust and [Ratatui](https://ratatui.rs), and refined through its own day-to-day use, it brings agents, review, and iteration into one focused terminal workflow. [Installation](#installation) · [Supported CLI Agents](#supported-cli-agents) · [Usage](#usage) · [Documentation](#documentation) · [Contributing](#contributing) · [License](#license)
______________________________________________________________________ ## Installation ### npm (recommended) The `npm`, Bun, and `pnpm` packages require Node.js on your `PATH`. Global installs support automatic updates through the original package manager when Agentty can identify it. ```sh npm install -g agentty ``` ### Other methods
Bun ```sh bun add --global agentty ```
pnpm ```sh pnpm add --global agentty ``` If `pnpm` reports a global bin-directory error, run `pnpm setup`, reopen your terminal, and retry.
npx (run without installing) ```sh npx agentty ```
Shell ```sh curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/agentty-xyz/agentty/releases/latest/download/agentty-installer.sh | sh ```
Cargo macOS source builds require Xcode Command Line Tools for native process bindings. ```sh cargo install agentty ```
## Supported CLI Agents Agentty currently supports Codex, Claude, and Antigravity. Install and authenticate at least one provider CLI before starting a session: - Codex (`codex`, recommended; supports subscription usage): install the [Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex) and run `codex login`. > [!NOTE] > > Codex is the recommended CLI agent for Agentty when you want subscription-backed > usage. Codex supports signing in with ChatGPT for subscription access, including in > the CLI, and Agentty uses the Codex `app-server` integration surface. Usage remains > subject to the [OpenAI Terms of Use](https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/). > OpenClaw documents ChatGPT/Codex subscription sign-in as the normal > [Codex harness](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness) path, and opencode > recommends ChatGPT Plus or Pro authentication for its > [OpenAI provider](https://opencode.ai/docs/providers/#openai). - Claude (`claude`): install [Claude Code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code) and run `claude auth login`. > [!WARNING] > > For Agentty usage through `claude -p`, use API key authentication through Claude > Console or a supported cloud provider instead of a Claude Free, Pro, or Max > subscription sign-in. Anthropic's > [Claude Code legal and compliance docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/legal-and-compliance) > describe subscription OAuth as intended for ordinary use of Claude Code and native > Anthropic applications, while developer integrations should use API keys or supported > cloud providers. Theo's > [explanation video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RIkSlHgQYog) discusses the same > uncertainty, but commentary does not guarantee that subscription-backed usage is safe > for third-party tool invocation. - Antigravity (`agy`): install version 1.1.18 or newer of the [Antigravity CLI](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli) and run `agy` to sign in when prompted. > [!WARNING] > > For Agentty usage through `agy` headless mode, use authentication backed by a Google > Cloud project or an API key when available for your Antigravity setup, rather than a > Google Account subscription sign-in. The > [Antigravity terms](https://antigravity.google/terms) do not yet clearly describe how > subscription access applies when `agy` headless mode is invoked by third-party tools. Agentty uses each provider's official non-interactive CLI or app-server surface (`claude -p`, `agy --input-format stream-json`, or `codex app-server`) after you authenticate with that provider's CLI. It does not implement OAuth flows, read provider OAuth tokens directly, or call private provider APIs. You are responsible for choosing an authentication method that is permitted for your account, plan, and usage pattern. ## Usage Launch Agentty from the repository you want to work in: ```sh agentty # Launch with auto-update enabled (default) agentty --no-update # Launch without automatic updates agentty --disable-telemetry # Launch without PostHog usage telemetry agentty --otlp-endpoint http://localhost:4318/v1/traces # Export session traces agentty --experimental-harness # Offer preview Harness sessions agentty --experimental-graph # Enable /graph proposals agentty --help # Show supported command-line options agentty --version # Show the installed Agentty version ``` - **Projects**: discovery is opt-in. In the **Projects** tab, add a repository by path (`a`) or scan a chosen folder (`d`). - **Instances**: only one Agentty instance can use a given Agentty root at a time. Separate `AGENTTY_ROOT` directories can run independently. - **Graphs**: `--experimental-graph` enables `/graph` proposals you can inspect, revise, and approve before any node runs. See the [workflow guide](https://agentty.xyz/docs/usage/workflow/). - **Harness**: `--experimental-harness` adds a preview session type that runs Agentty's built-in agent loop against local or hosted models. Its edit mode runs unsandboxed shell commands. See [Harness sessions](https://agentty.xyz/docs/agents/backends/#backends-harness). - **Tracing**: disabled unless `--otlp-endpoint` supplies a complete OTLP HTTP/protobuf traces URL. A URL ending in `/v1/traces` also sends usage events as OTLP log records to the sibling `/v1/logs` URL, even when telemetry is disabled. See [session traces](https://agentty.xyz/docs/usage/workflow/#session-traces). - **Telemetry**: enabled by default; release builds send usage events to the Agentty PostHog project. Pass `--disable-telemetry` to disable it; this is separate from OTLP export, which only sends data to your own `--otlp-endpoint`. See the [telemetry details](https://agentty.xyz/docs/usage/workflow/#telemetry). ## Documentation The programmatic session API supports creating and listing tasks before execution, submitting attempts, and explicitly accepting outcomes. See the [task contract](https://agentty.xyz/docs/core-components/durable-components/task/) for session ownership, concurrency, and current limits. It also supports explicit static execution graphs with isolated task conversations, exact output acceptance, and shared execution limits. See [execution graphs](https://agentty.xyz/docs/architecture/execution-graphs/) for supported profiles and lifecycle limits. Documentation for installation and workflows is available at [agentty.xyz/docs](https://agentty.xyz/docs/). > [!WARNING] > > Agentty is in active development. While releases follow Semantic Versioning, the > current `0.y.z` series may still introduce breaking changes between releases as > workflows, integrations, and safeguards evolve. Always review and verify the changes > Agentty proposes or applies in your repositories before you rely on them. ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for contribution guidance. ## License Apache-2.0

items.readme_text:
Vaultite

Own your memories. A local knowledge base you and your AI write together, in plain Markdown files.
Download (Intel) · Try it in your browser

## What it is A second brain for you and your AI: a folder of Markdown files (your vault) you both write in, which Vaultite draws as pages and a knowledge graph of what links to what. - **Plain files, no database.** Open the vault in another Markdown app, grep it, sync it with iCloud or keep it in git. - **Your Obsidian vault, as is.** Open it and its notes, links, properties and hotkeys carry over; with the Obsidian plugins add-on (Plugins, Get), 105 of the 126 community plugins checked work: Dataview, Templater, Tasks, Excalidraw, Kanban... - **Made for agents.** Claude Code, Codex and any MCP client share one set of operations (the `vau` CLI, MCP, HTTP). - **Everything is a plugin**, even the file tree, hot-reloaded. People, logs and notes come with it, off until a bundle or you turn them on. Write your own in the vault. - **A full editor and workspace**: live preview, tabs and splits, backlinks, graph and terminals for your agents, on the Mac, Linux and the web. iPhone coming soon. ## Get started 1. **Download** [Vaultite for Mac](https://github.com/Vaultite/vaultite/releases/latest/download/Vaultite-arm64.dmg) ([Intel](https://github.com/Vaultite/vaultite/releases/latest/download/Vaultite-x64.dmg); macOS 13 or later) and drag it to Applications. On Windows, the [installer](https://github.com/Vaultite/vaultite/releases/latest) (x64 or ARM64; not signed yet, so Windows asks: More info, Run anyway). On Linux, the [AppImage or the .deb](https://github.com/Vaultite/vaultite/releases/latest) (`sudo apt install ./vaultite_*.deb` also sets up Chromium's sandbox on Ubuntu 24.04+). 2. **Make a vault**, or open a folder of Markdown you already have: Vaultite changes none of it. Or try the playground, a made-up vault, first. 3. **Connect your AI** in Settings, AI: Claude, ChatGPT, Muse or Grok Bot, on the web and your phone (they reach Vaultite through Vaultite Cloud's relay or a tunnel of your own: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). Claude Code and Codex in Vaultite's terminals already know the vault. Then try "log a 30 minute run this morning" or "what did I tell you about Alice?". Layouts and packs add more: the Browser layout (Settings, Appearance) makes it a web browser first; in Plugins' Get, Life OS for your days, people and health, and Agents for your coding agents. Agents outside Vaultite: `claude mcp add vaultite -- vau mcp`. Skills that teach any agent the vault's rules and how to write a plugin: `npx skills add Vaultite/vaultite`, or in Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add Vaultite/vaultite` and `/plugin install vaultite@vaultite`. ## Run from source ```sh npm ci && npm run build # Node.js 23.6 or later node bin/vau sandbox /tmp/vaultite-sandbox # a made-up vault, dated as of today VAULTITE_VAULT=/tmp/vaultite-sandbox npm start # http://127.0.0.1:8793 ``` No accounts: keep it on `127.0.0.1` or a private network like Tailscale ([SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). The desktop and iPhone apps, tests and how to send a change: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Your own plugin: `vau plugin new ` ([vault plugins](core/docs/vault-plugins.md)). ## Run it on a server On a box at home or a VPS (Linux, a Mac or Windows), next to your agents. Open it from the desktop app (Connect to a server) or a browser on your tailnet. ```sh git clone https://github.com/Vaultite/vaultite && cd vaultite npm ci && npm run build # on Linux, node-pty builds with build-essential and python3 node bin/vau service install --vault ~/Vault # a systemd user unit (launchd on a Mac, a scheduled task on Windows), running now and at boot tailscale serve --bg --https=8447 http://127.0.0.1:8793 ``` Then add `https://..ts.net:8447` in the app. ## License [Apache 2.0](LICENSE). Obsidian is a trademark of Dynalist Inc. Vaultite is not affiliated with or endorsed by it; the name is used only to say what Vaultite is compatible with.
